article_title: Haematology centre for cancer patients at risk over 'disgraceful' funds move

tasks.prompt: What is the main issue described in the article?
options: Funding has been withdrawn from plans for a new Belfast haematology centre, putting the project at risk.
Belfast City Hospital has closed all cancer services immediately.
Northern Ireland has approved a second haematology centre ahead of schedule.
Hospital staff have voted against moving to a new building.
tasks.correct_answer: Funding has been withdrawn from plans for a new Belfast haematology centre, putting the project at risk.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת במשיכת המימון בסך 1.5 מיליון ליש״ט שנועד להעברת עובדים, צעד שמסכן את הקמת המרכז החדש.

tasks.prompt: How many staff did the Belfast Trust plan to relocate to make space for the centre?
options: About 20
About 80
About 150
More than 1,500
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, התכנית הייתה להעביר כ־80 עובדים מאזור בבית החולים כדי לפנות מקום ליחידה החדשה.

tasks.prompt: What does “withdrew funding” mean in the article?
options: Added extra money to the project
Delayed announcing the budget
Took back money that had been allocated
Moved the project to another hospital
tasks.correct_answer: Took back money that had been allocated
tasks.explanation_hebrew: withdrew funding פירושו שהמחלקה לקחה בחזרה כסף שכבר הוקצה לפרויקט.

tasks.prompt: What is the centre's current planned opening date?
options: March 2027
October 2028
January 2030
March 2031
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפרויקט כבר מפגר בשנה, ומועד הפתיחה המתוכנן הנוכחי נדחה למרץ 2031.

tasks.prompt: Why did assembly members argue that further delay could put patients at risk?
options: Many patients are severely immunocompromised and the current facilities lack enough isolation.
The new centre would provide free transport for hospital workers.
The hospital intends to stop employing specialised staff.
Cancer treatment can only take place outside Belfast.
tasks.correct_answer: Many patients are severely immunocompromised and the current facilities lack enough isolation.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מטופלי המטולוגיה עוברים טיפולים אינטנסיביים ומערכת החיסון שלהם פגיעה מאוד; היעדר בידוד מתאים מגדיל את הסיכון.

tasks.prompt: In this project, what does “decant” refer to?
options: Testing patients' blood before treatment
Reducing the number of cancer appointments
Reviewing the total construction cost
Moving staff out of an area so it can be used for the new unit
tasks.correct_answer: Moving staff out of an area so it can be used for the new unit
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר של הפרויקט decant הוא פינוי או העברה של עובדים מהאזור המיועד למרכז החדש.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons the Department of Health gave for withdrawing the £1.5m allocation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את שתי הסיבות שהובאו בדברי מנכ״לית הנאמנות.
expected_points: The department was not satisfied with the trust's options appraisal.
It questioned the robustness of the capital cost estimate.

tasks.prompt: Summarise what happened to the proposed centre and how the Belfast Trust is responding.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את מטרת המרכז, משיכת המימון, העיכוב וצעדי הנאמנות למציאת פתרון.
expected_points: The trust planned a new haematology centre at Belfast City Hospital for vulnerable cancer patients.
It needed to relocate about 80 staff, but the Department of Health withdrew £1.5m connected to that move.
The project is at risk and a year behind schedule, with opening currently planned for March 2031.
The trust is exploring other funding and escalating the issue to the department's permanent secretary.

tasks.prompt: Why did politicians describe the centre as a source of hope for cancer patients?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין מצב המטופלים, תנאי הבידוד הקיימים והיתרון הצפוי מיחידה ייעודית.
expected_points: Patients receive intense treatment and may be severely immunocompromised.
There are concerns about insufficient isolation in the current hospital conditions.
A dedicated centre could offer a safer environment with specialised staff.
Losing or delaying the project therefore feels especially serious for vulnerable patients.

tasks.prompt: Write a short public update using the words “allocation”, “relocate” and “vulnerable”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש נכון בשלושת המונחים, למסור את העובדות בלי להמציא פתרון או מועד חדש, ולשמור על ניסוח ברור.
expected_points: State that the £1.5m allocation was withdrawn.
Explain that about 80 staff must be relocated to make room.
Mention that the centre is intended for vulnerable haematology patients.
Avoid claiming that the project has been cancelled or that replacement funding is confirmed.
